name: HSM ROS2
description: Checks the diagram against the HSM-ROS2 robot API, generates the hsm_controller ROS 2 package, builds it with colcon and tests the diagram with the fake robot. Needs ROS 2 with the hsm_generator and hsm_interfaces packages, and hsm_tests with the hsmd dispatcher for the test.

parameters.label: ROS 2 setup script
parameters.description: The setup.bash providing hsm_generator and hsm_interfaces; empty: the editor's environment

parameters.label: Workspace
parameters.description: The colcon workspace of the generated package

parameters.label: Test duration, s
parameters.description: The run stops earlier when every expectation holds

parameters.label: Start X, m
parameters.description: The start position of the robot

parameters.label: Start Y, m
parameters.description: The start position of the robot

parameters.label: Start heading, rad
parameters.description: The start heading of the robot

parameters.label: Obstacle ahead, m
parameters.description: The distance the laser scan reports; 10: free space

parameters.label: Obstacle to the right, m
parameters.description: The distance the laser scan reports; 10: free space

parameters.label: Obstacle elsewhere, m
parameters.description: The distance the laser scan reports; 10: free space

parameters.label: Real-time timers
parameters.description: Run the timers at their real periods instead of the shortened ones

actions.label: Check the diagram
actions.description: Check the states, the transitions and the robot API usage

actions.label: Generate the package...
actions.description: Write the hsm_controller package into the src directory of the workspace

actions.label: Build the package
actions.description: Build the generated package with colcon; its output streams into the plugin's output tab

actions.label: Test with the fake robot...
actions.description: Run the diagram against the fake robot and check the expectations of its ros2 hsm test comment; the event timeline streams into the plugin's output tab
